claim_boundary: This claim records a reproducible scalar-gauge equivalence check between two AnyonWiki numeric category records. It asserts equivalence only within the multiplicity-free F/R convention model implemented by the cited checker; it does not independently prove that either record is SU(3)_2.

equivalence_claim.claim: The AnyonWiki FR_6_1_4_5 records cat_1_3_1 and cat_1_3_2 are scalar-gauge-equivalent presentations of the same braided multiplicity-free category data within the checked F/R convention model.
equivalence_claim.interpretation: Downstream code may choose either source record as a representative gauge, while recording the chosen representative and convention. The two AnyonWiki source-capture records remain separate provenance objects.
